_doc: Room speech heard in a node's follow-up window (no wake word): TestFollowUpAmbientEvalLive plays each line as a follow-up to its context's exchange against a real model. want: accept (must be answered), reject (must be not_for_me), either (not scored). voice: same = the voice that woke the node (no acoustic doubt), other = a different voice at the same level, far = a different voice from across the room or a TV (dropped before the model by the gate).
